digest.component_or_area: code-review gate, plan-review gate, completion verifier
propositions: The code-review gate's five LLM-calling steps (base, round_a, round_b, verify, coach) cannot express per-pass model class selection via a single REBAR_LLM_MODEL environment variable, causing Pass-1 and Pass-2/Pass-4 to incorrectly use the same model on non-default providers.

Per-step model declarations in code-review.yaml are not honored at runtime; steps inherit cfg.model implicitly despite declaring model or model_ladder, breaking the per-provider model routing mechanism.

On non-default providers (Bedrock), verifier downgrade logic (verify.py:269, completion.py:332) inverts because equality tests conflate operator override with provider change, causing Pass-2 and Pass-4 to skip sonnet downgrade and follow Pass-1's model.

A single knob (cfg.model or REBAR_LLM_MODEL) cannot simultaneously express four passes with different model classes: Pass-1 finder requires frontier (opus), while Pass-2 and Pass-4 require standard (sonnet).
The batch steps (round_a, round_b) cannot use step-level model declarations; only model_ladder inside the batch sub-dict is honored by the batch runner path.
Bare claude-* model ids in defaults resolve to provider anthropic during runs configured for another provider, defeating provider-specific class mapping.
